digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and adapter layer
propositions: Reconciler core reaches directly into Jira adapter with no named interface for alternate backends; Backend facade and role Protocols must define the contract for vendor-agnostic backend implementation.

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) detected via isinstance() checks must abstract the current Jira-specific call surface.
JiraBackend thin wrapper delegates to existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields, comment_limits) with zero behavior change and no logic relocation.

IdentityConvention pure object must encapsulate the currently inlined rebar-id:{local_id} label read/write convention (format RemoteRef to label string; parse label string back to RemoteRef) without rewiring core call sites.

Backend-agnostic contract suite and characterization tests must verify round-trip field mapping, sanitizer idempotency, identity convention correctness, and capability-gated dispatch against both JiraBackend with injected mock transport and test-only FakeBackend.
No core differ/apply/applier module rewiring occurs in this story; only new _backend.py, adapters/jira backend and identity modules, and test infrastructure are added.
